photos.title: Condo towers and smaller condo buildings on the ocean in Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: A stretch of oceanfront in the City of Myrtle Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: on the left the edge of a glass tower, a tall tower with a red roof line and a tall tan tower with a small cupola, each with a pool deck behind the dunes and wooden walkways over the dunes to the beach; to the right a paved beach access lot and a small playground, then a road that curves inland, with a white mid-rise, a gray low-rise and brown low-rise buildings with pools across it. Houses and a golf course sit among trees behind. Beach umbrellas line the sand. People are too small to recognize; no plate, sign or building name is readable.
photos.caption: Oceanfront condo towers in Myrtle Beach, with their pools behind the dunes, seen from a plane over the ocean.
photos.alt: Three tall oceanfront condo towers behind the dunes in Myrtle Beach, with smaller condo buildings across a curving road to the right and the beach and ocean in front

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size (3008 x 1960, in four quarters) by the writer on 2026-11-02. Horry County parcels layer 24, queried 2026-11-02 over the shore landward of the plane (envelope -78.8460 33.7150 to -78.8280 33.7320): every oceanfront parcel on this stretch is a condo regime, land use 107, tax district 880 (City of Myrtle Beach): Dunes Village, Pan American, Beach Colony Resort I and II, Southwind, Cabana I, Drayton House, The Anchorage and The Anchorage II, Ocean One, Forest Dunes, Porcher Villas, Sandcastle, Ocean Forest Plaza, A Place at the Beach. The houses behind are in the Dunes sections (land use 100 and 101). The caption names no building and says only that these are condo buildings on the ocean in Myrtle Beach, and the year. No sign or name is legible at page size; people are specks; no plate is readable.
